implementation_notes: New pure domain package backend/domain/match_assessment/ (schemas.py, policy.py, source_catalog.py, engine.py, __init__.py): no SQLAlchemy/Celery/LLM/HTTP imports; the engine takes validated semantic raw scores (DimensionInput) + deterministic rule facts (CapInput/GapInput) and returns an immutable MatchV1Result
Engine signature supports both MatchV1Input container and keyword form for the constrained semantic adapter (issue #108) to call
Recommendation bands are advisory labels from the policy fixture (recommendation_for) - never authorization guards; low scores do not block Interview Plan eligibility (RIP-013 6.5)

Gap classification: the engine records the semantic adapter's primary category; when the adapter marks uncertain=True the engine applies the spec rule that evidence_gap wins; deterministic rule facts pass uncertain=False and their category is recorded as-is

One fixture bug found and fixed while gating: policy _validate_fixture used an inverted cap-ordering comparison (>= instead of <=) which raised on the correct 75>70 fixture at import; corrected so the invariant now actually validates
Skill alias table extended with react.js -> react fixed-point entries so normalize_skill is a stable normalization (alias values are themselves fixed points, asserted in tests)
residual_risks: Source Catalog builder takes version structured dicts/snapshots as inputs; the application-layer wiring that loads them from persisted versions lands with the assessment lifecycle (issue #109)
Constrained semantic classification (LLM adapter, evidence validation, malicious-input handling) lands in issue #108; the engine's classify hook is ready for it
Persistence (match_assessments table), worker, and API land in issues #109/#110; none of that is claimed here

reviews.note: Domain-pure match-v1 core implemented and gated: exact weights, import-time fixture validation, typed citeable Source Catalog, two-decimal weighted totals, 75/70 caps with lowest-wins, evidence_gap for unknown years, one primary gap per requirement with evidence_gap-wins-on-uncertainty, action-type derivation. 58 unit tests cover all boundary combinations; full gates green (unit 404/2 pre-existing, integration 114, ruff/mypy 0 new, arch 0 new, no migration)
